# Review Checklist: Push Manager Check

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements (clarity, measurability, scope boundaries) before implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is "one-line comment" defined precisely as a single physical line, including its trailing newline handling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK002 Is the required comment syntax stated unambiguously (HTML comment) rather than only "Markdown/HTML comment"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK003 Is the comment's required content ("briefly state its purpose") bounded by length or mandatory terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK004 Is the placement requirement ("end of the README") stated as a normative requirement rather than only an assumption? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Are the "exactly one added line" requirement and the allowance for this feature's spec artifacts consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK006 Does FR-005 ("no configuration changes") align with the edge-case wording ("no other files besides the README")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK007 Can "rendered README is visually identical" be objectively measured, and is the rendering target named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK008 Is the baseline for the diff (main branch) specified for SC-001 and SC-002? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK009 Is "reviewed and approved in under 1 minute" measurable, with a defined reviewer and start point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK010 Is the "existing automated tests" suite identified so SC-003 has a defined scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are requirements defined for the case where the README already ends without a trailing newline? [Gap, Edge Case] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for the case where the same comment already exists (re-run/idempotency)? [Gap, Recovery] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK013 Are requirements specified for what counts as a successful pipeline check (push, PR created) beyond the diff content? [Gap, Spec §User Story 1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK014 Is the assumption that the comment is hidden on the hosting platform's renderer validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK015 Is the pipeline being verified ("push manager") defined, so the purpose is traceable? [Gap, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
